changeinfo.changes:
Adds a number of feature requests from players and addresses some player reported bugs:
  • Update to the hit formula. You (and monsters) will now miss less!
  • Added a Run button.
  • Added a "game-time" clock to see how long you've been playing each chapter.
  • Graphics and Music can now be swapped between 8-bit and 16-bit modes independently.
  • Can now move more quickly after battle.
  • Bug fixes.
